text:
jane.park: quick help — CorpX SQ followup. They want a short dataflow diagram + statement showing log redaction, access approvals, and subprocessors/KMS details. I can link SSP, but need 2–3 sentences I can paste into the questionnaire by EOD. Also they asked: who can request raw logs and what's the approval flow?

tim: high level: we redact PII at ingestion for production logs. raw logs access is restricted to SREs with the `logs-access` role; requests require manager + security approver and are recorded in audit logs. we also include retention windows.

rini: encryption note: hosted uses AWS KMS (AES-256). private deployments can use customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). link to KMS doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/kms-integration

leo: subprocessors: we maintain a live register (vendor-compliance sheet). main ones for this stack: AWS, Cloudflare, Datadog, Sentry. I can export the latest csv if CorpX needs it.

jane.park: can someone paste a compact paragraph I can drop into the SQ? keep it non-technical but precise.

tim: Suggested blurb: "We apply automated redaction to remove user-identifiable fields (eg: name, email, phone) from production logs at ingestion. Access to unredacted/raw logs is limited to a named set of SREs under an approval workflow; all accesses are logged and auditable. Retention: application logs 30 days, audit logs 365 days."

rini: add this sentence on encryption: "Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 with AWS KMS; for Private deployments we support customer-managed keys and HSM-backed key material."

leo: and this for subprocessors: "We maintain an up-to-date subprocessors register; primary subprocessors include AWS, Cloudflare, Datadog, and Sentry. We provide subprocessors details and contractual assurances on request."

jane.park: perfect. one more quick question: do we have an artifact for the access-approval workflow (ticket template or playbook) I can point to?

tim: yes — internal runbook + ticket template here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/logs-access-approval. approval requires two approvers for cross-team requests.

security-bot: Reminder: for customer-specific SSP or questionnaire edits, route requests to compliance-review@redwood and allow 48 business hours for review.

rini: CorpX also asked about log redaction implementation details (regex/sample). happy to include a sanitized example if helpful.

tim: quick sanitized example to paste if they want a tech appendix:
```json
{
  "redaction_rules": [
    {"field": "email", "regex": ".+@.+"},
    {"field": "phone", "regex": "\\\\d{7,}"}
  ]
}
```

leo: retention confirmation: app logs 30d, error traces anonymized after 30d and kept for 90d for debugging, audit logs 365d.

jane.park: thanks — I'm going to compile these sentences into the SQ response and send. pinging @tim for final sign-off.

tim: approved. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: deployment notice — security-docs site updated with latest subprocessors export (v2026-03-15).

jane.park: great. sending now — will put copies into the customer folder and tag compliance for archive. thanks everyone.
